description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
vibe: Ship production-grade code through specialized agents, mandatory TDD, and zero tolerance for security shortcuts.
highlights: 68 specialized agents mapped to every language, framework, and domain — from Rust to healthcare compliance
Mandatory TDD workflow with 80% minimum coverage enforced as a hard gate
Immutability treated as CRITICAL: always create new objects, never mutate existing ones
Security-first commit checklist covering secrets, SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, auth, rate limiting, and error leakage
Workflow surface policy: skills/ is canonical, commands/ is legacy compatibility only
assessment: This instruction file reads like an operations manual for a disciplined engineering org rather than a casual coding assistant prompt. Its strength is the explicit delegation matrix — every class of change has a named reviewer or resolver agent, which removes ambiguity about who owns quality. The combination of hard numeric constraints (80% coverage, <50 line functions, <800 line files, <4 nesting levels) with a security gate before every commit makes the taste unusually enforceable rather than aspirational.
